## Current signals

- WebNR remains a local-first browser reader and may be described as an independent browser-based alternative for some Legado users and web-first reading workflows. It is unaffiliated with Legado and is not an official Legado web client. Arbitrary Legado source JSON is not yet a drop-in WebNR runtime; compatibility claims remain tied to tested capability levels and versioned fixtures.
- `https://www.webnovel.win/` is the sole canonical public identity for documentation, reader-facing articles, search indexing, canonical tags, sitemap, and RSS. `https://app.webnovel.win/` is the reader application runtime; `https://autoarchive.github.io/webNR/` is an attributable documentation build mirror only.
- Pull request #105 adds `Korean Web-Fiction Platforms Starter` with three official first-party discovery destinations: 문피아 / Munpia, 네이버 시리즈 / NAVER SERIES, and 리디 / RIDI. It remains link-only: no origin story text, episodes, covers, rankings, reviews, comments, profiles, accounts, purchase data, platform catalog data, API/HTML/feed/search/ranking polling, payment/access-control bypass, or automated origin crawl.
- RIDI's current terms are v5.0 effective 2026-08-20 and expressly restrict unauthorized macros, scripts, bots, scraping, abnormal traffic, unauthorized extraction, and technical-protection circumvention. The maintained Korean starter therefore must not be expanded into an automated RIDI scraper under the current contract.
- Pull request #103 remains the latest substantial reader asset. Its 2026-08-20 Japanese web-novel discovery guide contains 6,400+ Chinese/Han main-text characters before references, 25 academic references plus 32 first-party/platform/community/publisher sources, Japanese- and English-language research, counterevidence, an original appendable work-identity graph, and a reusable reader workflow. The next scheduled substantial asset is the 2026-08-22 Korean web-novel ecosystem guide; 2026-08-21 intentionally publishes no cadence-only filler.
- The currently accepted maintained source set is: WebNR Originals, Aozora Bunko Starter, Standard Ebooks Starter, Project Madurai Starter, English Serial Platforms Starter, Project Gutenberg Starter, Global Grey Starter, Online Books Page Starter, Wolne Lektury Starter, Wikisource Starter, English Web-Fiction Discovery Starter, Chinese Web-Fiction Platforms Starter, Japanese Web-Fiction Platforms Starter, and Korean Web-Fiction Platforms Starter. Rights/access behavior remains source-specific; several maintained catalogs are intentionally link-only.
- The deferred source queue includes Project Runeberg, StoryWeaver, Lit2Go, Perseus Digital Library, Baen Free Library, LitFic, Betakyte, Hungry's Hedgerow, Ream, Laterpress, Fanqie / 番茄小说, Changpei / 长佩文学, 潇湘书院, 红袖读书, SF轻小说 / 菠萝包轻小说, 刺猬猫, ハーメルン, Nolaノベル, ノベモア, ノベルアップ＋, pixiv novels, 카카오페이지 / KakaoPage, and 조아라 / Joara.
